_about: One entry per lesson: exactly what goes into Gemini Notebook. scripts/video/sync_gemini_notebook.py builds gemini-notebook/<slug>/ from this file and regenerates Prompts/<slug>-upload-files.txt. Edit this file, not the generated ones. Sources of truth stay in lessons/, course-assets/, and Prompts/. 'uploads' are copied into upload/ in this order; 'post_only' boards contain faces, are never uploaded, and replace their 'covers' upload variant in the edit.

lessons.title: Document Trap
lessons.notes: v1 SHIPPED 2026-09-21, stitched rather than rolled: roll 7 is the spine with four grafts from rolls 8 and 3. Ten rolls never landed the eleven required lines in one take - rolls 7 and 8 reached 7 of 10, and the 9/21 kit revision aimed at the three stragglers made it worse (rolls 9 and 10, 3 of 11), so the revision was abandoned in favour of assembling the best take of each beat. Three lines are spoken a word off ('it was JUST incomplete', 'THE document trap is thinking...', 'doesn't mean THE AI has read it all') because no roll anywhere says them clean, and 'In this example, the tournament rule allows six fouls.' is unspoken by every roll - if this lesson is ever rerolled, those four sentences are the thing to fix in the Markdown, not the prompt's layout. Kit sits on the 2026-09-20 recipe; rebuild only if a reroll is ever needed.

lessons.title: Support Trap

post_only.why: faces; Board 1 narration reserved in the Markdown

lessons.notes: v4 SHIPPED 2026-09-21: roll 1 spine with three grafts and one added pause. Roll 1 is the only version that speaks both safety-critical lines exactly - the content note and 'In the U.S., call or text 988 for crisis support. Call 911 if someone is in immediate danger.' - but it INVENTED A CAUSE in the account of a real death ('Because she relied on the bot, the AI's isolated digital environment actively held details...'), which the prompt forbids; the live video's 2026-09-19 repaired passage replaces it. Roll 2 supplies 'Know When to Leave the Chat', which roll 1 drops; roll 2 is not a base (its content note and 988/911 wording are not exact and it drops 'by suicide'). The live video also supplied its CONTENT WARNING card and 'A quick note before we continue' lead-in (David: 'I do like the way the live video has the content warning at 2:00'), with roll 1's exact wording kept underneath and 3.96 s of silence under the card. KNOWN GAP: Board 2 is thin in every version - no roll speaks all three 'what can be real' items or all four 'what is missing' items - and only a reroll fixes it.
